name: mstack-setup
description: Check and install what the mstack skills need, at user scope, on Linux, macOS and Windows: a status script for the host, then one list of install commands (codegraph, ponytail, the cross-vendor reviewer, the mstack skills) that runs only after one yes, and a final check. One skill for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Install what the mstack skills need, after one yes.
interface.longDescription: Runs a status script that reports each dependency of the mstack skills for this host (installed, missing, not logged in, or loading in a new session), then shows one list of install commands grouped as mandatory and optional, runs only the ones the user accepts, continues past a failure, and checks again. Covers Linux, macOS and Windows and writes nothing into the current repository.
